question: In India, the western cyclonic disturbances are weather phenomena of the winter months brought in by the westerly flow from the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mediterranean region.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mediterranean region**

 
 
• **​**The area surrounding the **Mediterranean Sea** is known as the Mediterranean region. This includes places in **Asia, Africa, and Europe.**
 
• The majority of the region has a Mediterranean **climate with mild to mildly wet winters** and **summers that range from hot to dry.**
 
• The **short trees and shrubs** that grow there can withstand the annual summer drought</st
